lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; restatement accepted. i8995 p. 3, "When losses or deductions previously suspended by other Code provisions are allowed in calculating taxable income", their qualified portion is treated as a loss carryforward (Line 3). The project asks those losses at qbi.suspended ("In 2025, are you (or, on a joint return, your spouse) deducting a business loss or expense of an earlier year that a tax limit kept you from deducting then?") and refuses a Yes through qbi.unsupported on qbi.deduction, so on every return it completes line 3 is the earlier Form 8995 line 16 carryforward alone. The reworded source (BUG-0849: the latest Form 8995 from 2024 or earlier) is what occasioned this review.
